{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies bitcoinkernel C/C++ public API headers and implementations to provide structured logging and sever dependencies on node logging code.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Replaces string-based log delivery with structured btck_LogEntry structs, removing the need for callers to parse formatted strings to obtain metadata. This decouples the kernel from node logging internals (logging.cpp), advancing the core kernel goal of eliminating node dependencies and unblocking downstream work like #30342 and #33847."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The only change touching tests outside kernel-specific unit tests is an incidental addition to valgrind.supp.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to valgrind suppressions and kernel unit tests only follow directly from the kernel logging changes and do not affect general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp, which is the bitcoinkernel example binary rather than an operator tool.",
      "band": "Unranked",
